name: Virtual Analog Variant
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Emilie Gillet's two alternate virtual-analog designs preserved in the Plaits source, unified: a detuned or hard-synced second oscillator on one trajectory, with independently spread waveshapes.

controls.label: Interval
controls.description: Detune interval: unison at noon, stepping by fifths and octaves to two octaves up or down. Also sets the AUX sync ratio.

controls.label: Waveshape
controls.description: Changes both oscillators together from saw through square to narrow pulse.

controls.label: Detune to sync
controls.description: Below noon fades in the detuned oscillator; at noon only the primary sounds; above noon crossfades into hard sync.

controls.label: Shape spread
controls.description: Spreads the two waveshapes around TIMBRE, the primary half as far as the secondary; at noon both match.

outputs.main: Mono: the primary with the detuned or hard-synced oscillator, as set by MORPH. Stereo: left channel, a point just below the primary/detuned mix.
outputs.aux: Mono: the primary against a hard-synced oscillator at the HARMONICS ratio, half and half. Stereo: right channel, a point just above the primary/detuned mix.

trigger: The oscillator phases free-run; patched TRIG restarts Plaits' shared decay and low-pass-gate envelope.
upstream: Mutable Instruments eurorack Plaits source, original VA_VARIANT 0 and 1 unified, with Plaits Palette macro and stereo integration
